text_block_list.text:
I spotted Mejiro Palmer and the others 
training ahead of an upcoming race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Seriously exhausted~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no time to tire out over just this! 
The distance and rivals ahead are gonna be 
insanely stacked.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Dude, that's seriously mega hype and fun! 
Means we're part of that super hyped 
lineup, right?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Gotta crank up the vibes right now! Party 
time! Our massive runaway will blow the 
roof clean off the stadium!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Totally! Stacked field means we gotta 
raise the roof even harder!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, idea♪ Wanna check out that "Freestyle 
Race" I used to run in? It gets super wild 
and hype!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Freestyle Race"! Now that's the real 
deal~! Hype levels off the charts, party 
time!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's head over right now♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you there! Come along if you're 
curious!

Intrigued by their conversation, I ended 
up following Mejiro Palmer.

Half out of worry and half out of 
curiosity, I tagged along to see...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Long time no see, everyone! Looking good!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Palmer! That jersey... You really got 
into Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Waaaay! Party time! 'Sup, 'suuup!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: Way-waaaay!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Is this person with you too, Palmer? Wait, 
that badge... a Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, we hang out together quite a bit.

It seemed the horse girls gathered here 
held unofficial races for all kinds of 
personal reasons.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: So, what brings you here today?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
We've got a big race coming up soon, 
y'know. Came here to pump up our hype!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Reliving the reckless, all-out days, huh? 
Sounds awesome! I'll help out!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll be your first opponent! I've got 
a ton of pent-up stress from my part-time 
job anyway!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Plus, I wanna see what Tracen Academy 
talent looks like. I haven't given up on 
getting in myself!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah! You're on!

The race took place on a quiet country 
backroad. Yet, what unfolded before my 
eyes was truly breathtaking.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Haha, a dead heat...?!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Palmer, you're crazy good after all! You 
really leveled up! And Helios too! Never 
seen an explosive front-running runaway 
like that!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, everyone brought insane hype vibes, 
so I could give it my absolute all! Party 
time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It took me right back to where I started. 
Taking a positive escape here was the best 
call ever!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Helios, I remembered all about 
this place today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You're seriously my shining sun! Thanks a 
bunch, Helios!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Right back atcha! Made new besties, and 
got to sprint like crazy—seriously stoked♪ 
Hype!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yep! We're an iconic duo! Let's enjoy the 
real deal with everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Roger that! Now that we had our pre-party 
hype fest, let's show 'em a whole 'nother 
level! Party time!

And then came race day. The two who broke 
out into a massive runaway from the 
opening stretch...
(WAAAAAAAAHHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
(Whoa, what the heck?! Palmer's on another 
level?! I'm already struggling to keep 
up!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
(Palmer's run is straight fire, though!! 
Getting to watch this up close is mega 
epic!!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh!! Go win thiiiiiiiiiiis!! 
Paーーーーーーalmeーーーーーーーーr!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaーーーーーーーーhhh!!!

With Daitaku Helios at her back, Mejiro 
Palmer claimed a glorious 1st place 
victory!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! That was the absolute best...!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Huge congrats!! Hype!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! I'm gonna keep positive-running 
away with everything I've got from now on!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: For real...?!

Just when they were right there, both of 
them ran out of steam... Their massive 
runaway lead fell short of the finish 
line.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(We didn't make it...! But I feel like I 
can see the path to victory now...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Even if everyone's calling it just a 
brainless runaway right now, there's no 
way I'm letting things end like this!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It hurts to lose, but if we're gonna be 
idiots about it, let's go full idiot all 
the way to the very end!

In Mejiro Palmer's eyes as she stood on 
the track, one could feel a fierce, 
unyielding fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah. Once you take the plunge and 
just break away, you realize just how big 
the world really is.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
We'll definitely be cheering for you! 
Palmer, Helios, do your best out there, 
both of you!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, 'cause we made a pinky promise to 
throw an after-party the second the race 
wraps up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Getting ahead of yourself as always! 
Alright then, let's break away straight 
toward a bright, fun future!

And then came race day. The two who broke 
away into a massive lead right from the 
start...
(WOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: YEEEEEEAAAAAAAHHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
(For real...?! Palmer, you are seriously 
wicked crazy!!)

And that was how everyone bore witness to 
Mejiro Palmer's positive breakaway.
